ideas.pitch: An offline, local-only multi-actuator home automation controller powered by embedded speech recognition for lighting, fans, and electronic locks without cloud dependencies.
ideas.problem_statement: PS-001: Offline Multi-Actuator Home Automation Hub
ideas.title: EdgeVoice Home Hub
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly hits the strict hardware track requirement of completely local wake-word and command processing without any cloud speech APIs, making it stand out against generic cloud-connected clones during a live demo.

ideas.pitch: An intelligent microcontroller-based lighting system that dynamically matches ambient natural light and room occupancy via local sensor arrays while logging localized energy savings.
ideas.title: EcoLux Adaptive Ambient Controller
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates sophisticated closed-loop sensor fusion and local mathematical optimization running entirely on a microcontroller, perfectly matching the hardware track's emphasis on edge computation.

ideas.pitch: A standalone, low-power automated irrigation system for balcony planters driven by localized soil moisture matrices and strict scheduling logic.
ideas.title: SproutSync Balcony Irrigation
ideas.why_it_could_win: Fulfills the constraint of avoiding cloud weather dependencies by utilizing localized deterministic scheduling algorithms combined with real-time moisture feedback.

ideas.pitch: An interactive Generative AI platform built to transform educational curriculums into personalized micro-learning paths and real-time concept explanation graphs.
ideas.problem_statement: EduGenAI Track: Powered by ACM Student Chapter - SRMIST Tiruchirappalli
ideas.title: EduGenAI Adaptive Concept Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages domain-specific RAG pipelines to solve real classroom learning bottlenecks, aligning directly with the ACM Student Chapter sponsor track evaluation criteria.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered transaction risk analysis and investigation workspace that combines graph-based entity relationships with explainable ML models to flag anomalous public sector banking activities.
ideas.problem_statement: Smart Systems Track: Digital Healthcare Banking Public Sector Banking Fraud Detection
ideas.title: SecureFlow Banking Fraud Detection
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts proven financial crime investigation workflows to public sector banking priorities, satisfying the track's banking fraud detection scope with high visual and analytical impact.
